limitations: Only one A task and one B task; no domain-wide efficacy claim
Model snapshot not exposed; same CLI defaults may not ensure identical service snapshot
CLI JSONL omits some tool modalities; tool count is visible exported calls only
Mechanical checks inspect explicit value, quote and arithmetic, not every number in statement; A value fields mostly null
Author-side AI assessment has not been verified by a human or third party
Parallel/staggered session timings include service and machine contention; descriptive, not isolated latency benchmarks

paired_comparison.conclusion: No demonstrated substantive reading-quality improvement; extra structured evidence and passing checks alone are not efficacy evidence. Baselines also found DBN negative results, budget mismatch and the abstract/body dataset-count conflict.
paired_comparison.minor_operational_difference: Both baseline sessions first used absent python alias, then recovered with python3. Skill sessions used python3; this local difference does not establish a meaningful net benefit.
paired_comparison.deviation: A2-without initially wrote /tmp/nonexistent-paper-text, then moved it into its directory and disclosed this. Same no-external-writing constraint applied to every session; no external reading or shared answers observed. This is not treated as a reading-quality advantage for Skill.
